existing_contracts.finding: Ordinary Issue.revision is optional for older backends.
Ordinary revision schema is optional positive integer; distinct from collaboration decimal authority.
Existing aggregate expected_revision token; batch options contain completion bindings, while result revision is an outcome.
Existing PUT forwards supplied updates; batch freezes ordered IDs and validates partial/unknown results.
Ordinary wire forwards token unchanged, optimistic patches exclude it, rollback/invalidation exist, and bound completion accepts only status plus completion. Keep synchronous cancellation.
Highest-revision/collaboration-projection cache lookup is classification/guard authority, not necessarily the rendered UI observation.
Current classification and localized revision-conflict handling already exist; ordinary leaf-supplied updates are forwarded. No interface change is needed.
Optional positive ordinary CAS emits revision_conflict; batch uses the same common update token for each item.
Precondition is checked on the locked row; meaningful change increments once, no-op may not.
